purpose: Semantic list container for like rows: empty state, density, day groups, a shared status column, and announced live insertion.
useWhen: Rendering a vertical list of like records where each row shares the same layout.
Pairing with StackedListItem rows for leading/title/description/meta/trailing content.
Showing a dedicated empty state when the collection has no items.
Grouping rows under day headers, or announcing rows that arrive while the list is on screen.

avoidWhen.reason: Presenting key-value metadata for a single entity — use description-list instead.
Rendering tabular data with rows and columns — use table instead.
